claim_language: Validation-cycle hybrid selective-action candidate; not a benchmark, holdout, production-policy, or LLM-first claim.

fires_only_if: saved state-graph data contain an asserted current unknown or unresolved boundary-state node
row is not made wrong from a deterministic-correct baseline
projection_boundary_state_priority_gate_.attribution: deterministic semantic arbitration, not normalization and not LLM-first

fires_only_if: llm_candidate_selector_raw is scorable after the frozen label-normalization path used by the replay
row belongs to frozen rescue families unknown_boundary, seizure_free_duration, or current_vs_historical
projection gate did not already change the row
row is not made wrong from a deterministic-correct baseline
llm_candidate_sidecar_rescue_gate_v0.attribution: hybrid clinical selection under deterministic safety-floor constraints, not LLM-first

frozen_scorer_and_repair_policy.change_policy: If any forbidden change is required, stop and write a new validation-cycle manifest.

allowed_surfaces: full validation750 aggregate over saved source artifact
fixed hard-slice summaries using frozen hard-slice manifest
hidden-family summaries from frozen atlas labels
row-level would-change tables for validation rows only

required_reporting: row count and unique source-row count
explicit callout for non-obvious prediction/scorer/gold relationships including unknown versus multiple per 13 month

validation_row_level_allowed_for: rows changed by an individual component gate
changed rows without exact evidence or valid source ids
fallbacks or abstentions whose reason affects promotion language
known unknown versus multiple per 13 month scoring-convention row
inspection_policy.locked_test_requirement: Any locked-test use requires a separate frozen-test audit plan.

promote_within_validation_cycle_if_all: correct-to-wrong transitions are 0 or fully explained as scorer-equivalent nonsemantic changes
changed-label precision remains at least 0.95 on fixed hard slices
every changed row has exact evidence and valid source ids
projection and LLM-sidecar contributions remain separately attributable
known scoring-convention caveat is documented row by row
replay report preserves baseline and component-layer accounting
revise_if_any: improvements concentrate in a Gan-specific convention rather than a reusable boundary-state or clinical-selection mechanism
LLM sidecar mostly abstains outside the already inspected hard slices
candidate improves fixed slices but does not produce interpretable full-validation changed-label accounting
candidate depends on ambiguous source provenance or weak sidecar normalization
reject_if_any: any deterministic-correct row becomes wrong without an explicitly accepted scorer-equivalent explanation
any changed row lacks exact evidence or valid source ids
any gate uses gold labels, oracle correctness, or locked-test behavior
a scorer, repair, graph, prompt, schema, model, or source-artifact change is required to reproduce the result under this manifest

locked_test_policy: Out of scope. A future holdout run requires a separate frozen-test audit plan and a new freeze.
